text:
The Jets are winless in five (0-3-2) and coming off a 2-1 home loss to Montreal in the Heritage Classic, missing Josh Morrissey and Vladislav Namestnikov. With Morrissey out, Neal Pionk is up to 26:09 a night and Mario Ferraro has moved in beside DeMelo. Florida won 3-2 in Chicago two days ago and sits 3-2-0 over its last five, but Brad Marchand and Aleksander Barkov are both on injured reserve. Carter Verhaeghe has stepped into their spot beside Reinhart and Tkachuk, and Lars Eller is playing 17:19 a night.

The chances favor Florida. At five on five the Panthers have taken 55% of the expected goals (the quality of shots each side creates) against 46% for Winnipeg, and our model has FLA at 3.23 expected goals tonight to 2.94 for the Jets. Florida's weak spot is discipline: 5.8 penalties a game.

In net, projected starter Stuart Skinner has saved 6.1 goals more than the shots deserved this season, while Akira Schmid sits at minus 1.8. Skinner finished last season at plus 6.0, Schmid at minus 1.1.

Sam Reinhart (36% to score) and Kyle Connor (45%, and 73% for a point) lead the lists. As our under-the-radar picks, we'd watch Brady Tkachuk, who plays about 15:42 on the third line but has 11 high-danger shots in his last 10 games, and Cole Perfetti, at 56% for a point, above his season pace.
